entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to figure out how to return this ridiculous helmet and your website is useless. I want to send it back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. So I can pull up your order, could you please provide me with the order number?
Ugh, fine. It's VF88602. Look, the box is unopened. It's been sitting here for a bit but I just decided the color is completely wrong. I'm not wearing it.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF88602. Yes, I see the order for the Aero-Vent helmet here. It looks like it was delivered about 57 days ago.

So what? Are you telling me I can't return it? This is unbelievable! I want to speak to a manager right now! This is a simple return! A matter of safety is at stake if the helmet color isn't right for visibility. I will light you up on every review site on the internet if you don't give me my money back!

Sir, I completely understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can resolve this for you right now. I've just confirmed the policy. Since the helmet was delivered 57 days ago, it's still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Wait, really? So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. As you said the box is unopened and it's within the timeframe, so I am processing your return authorization right now. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Is that one still correct?
Oh. Yeah, that's the right email. So I just print the label?

That's correct. Just print it, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually takes 3-5 business days after we get it.
Okay. Well... good. That's all I needed.
I'm glad I could help you with that. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great afternoon.
